verdict.rationale: The pack shows no public claim grounded in USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or linked official policy citations. The headline 98.5% approval rate is published as a bare number with no stated case count or time window. The resource guides, including the RFE guide, give practical advice but are not shown citing government data or linking to policy sources.

support.subject: As a developer evaluating providers, the provider grounds its public claims in government data — USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or official policy citations with links
